quotations.old_english: Annanias ðec and Adzarias and Misael Metod dómige
quotations.english: Hananiah and Azariah and Mishael may glorify thee, O Lord

source_text: dómian; p. ode; pp. od [dóm justice, glory] To praise, glorify; celebr&a-long;re, gloriam tribu&e-short;re :-- Annanias ðec and Adzarias and Misael Metod dómige Hananiah and Azariah and Mishael may glorify thee, O Lord, Cd. 192; Th. 241, 4; Dan. 399; 192; Th. 239, 19; Dan. 372.
